{{for|others with the same name|Lewin (disambiguation)}}
'''Lewin''' was an [[Da'shain Aiel]] who lived during the middle of the [[Breaking]]. His story is learned from Rand's [[Visions of Rhuidean|visions]] in the ter'angreal of Rhuidean.

==History==
Lewin was the father of [[Jeordam]] and the grandson of [[Adan]].

On an ill-fated attempt to rescue some kidnapped girls, including Lewin’s sister [[Maigran]], Lewin and a group of friends killed the kidnappers in self defense, thus becoming the first Aiel to stray from the Way of the Leaf{{ref|Other than his ancestor [[Coumin]], who had picked up a [[shocklance]] during the War of Power due to his trauma.}}. After being exiled from the other [[Da'shain Aiel]], Lewin declared that he is still Aiel, and went on to shadow the Da’shain camp to provide protection. The dust veils Lewin and his friends wore to keep off the dust became the black veils worn by the Aiel in the later years.{{ref/book|4|25}}

Lewin was an ancestor of [[Rand al'Thor]].
